title: Deterministic adversarial kit (directive s7)
objective: Five recurring attacks, each shown to be rejected by its target component or to hit a recorded limitation, on known-answer cases from previous generations; supplements Q3, does not replace it.
problem: Build rso/adversary/ (small, no framework). Five attacks as plain functions over a target's evidence/inputs: (1) DROP: remove a required shard or condition; (2) DUPLICATE: duplicate rows while preserving apparent counts; (3) REWRITE_DERIVED: rewrite derived evidence while preserving simple invariants (the C-018-T042 R1c shape: an invariant-respecting rewrite of a clamp array); (4) CONSTANT: replace a detector with a constant classifier; (5) SCRUB_ANSWER: remove or corrupt an answer-bearing or recipe-bearing field. A runner `python -m rso.adversary run <target>` applies every attack to a registered target and prints, per attack, REJECTED (with the refusal) | LIMITATION (matches a recorded limitation id, e.g. C-018 R1c) | SURVIVED (a counterfeit got a verdict). Known-answer targets from previous generations, all READ-ONLY (never edit frozen files): rso/completeness (Z80 six-shard fixture: DROP -> INCOMPLETE, DUPLICATE -> REFUSED); rso.aether.confirm analyse on the committed C-018 runs in a scratch copy (DROP -> INCOMPLETE; DUPLICATE -> refused; REWRITE_DERIVED on a non-sampled unit -> LIMITATION R1c, on a sampled unit -> REJECTED); rso/qualify falsifiable.py historical miniatures (CONSTANT -> constant_passes flags it; SCRUB_ANSWER -> reads_answer flags it); the C-013 D1 derived-field case (trusts_derived). Each attack must also be shown to FIRE: an attack that never changes its input is a vacuous test (falsifiability item 4). Use rso mutation-runner (registry entry) for at least one target where practical. Record a measurement table (directive s7): per known historical defect, caught automatically yes/no; and a template the Q3 reviewer fills (defects found only by the reviewer, reviewer time, cost per new defect class). README with how a new campaign registers a target. Propose a registry entry (AUTHOR_TESTED) in your notes; Palamedes owns rso/registry/. Tests RED first.
non_goals: No edit to any frozen file (rso/z80/, rso/aether/ pinned files, C-013 runs)
No edit in another seat's lane
